Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 132. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 15 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: When you take the attack action or
roll a Combo Attack Roll with a qualifying weapon
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
You add energy to your weapon sending ki facsimiles
of your attacks. For the duration of this technique your
melee weapons gain a 30 foot range and have their
damage changed to Ki damage.
